environment.description: ECS Fargate container running in a public subnet with an Application Load Balancer forwarding all traffic directly to the container on port 8080. Security group allows inbound from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 80. No CloudFront distribution in front. Task role has basic ECS execution permissions. Container runs with default Fargate platform version 1.4.0.

config.networking: Public subnet, ALB with public DNS
config.container_restart_policy: none - ECS service desired_count=1, no health check grace period
